meta.title: Lider Digital Archive – AI Document Digitization | LumiVerse
meta.description: AI-powered digitization of 50,000+ magazine articles: custom OCR, layout detection and Croatian NLP turning decades of print into structured data.

en.title: Lider Digital Archive
en.subtitle: Decades of business journalism, locked in PDFs. We built an AI pipeline that extracted, structured, and indexed 50,000+ articles – making them searchable and ready for the age of AI.

showcase.alt: Original Lider magazine page showing complex multi-column layout with images and Croatian text - demonstrating the complexity of documents processed
showcase.caption: Original magazine page showing the complex layouts our AI pipeline processes

sections.title: Not Your Typical OCR Job
sections.lede: Magazine layouts break standard document processing – multi-column text, images that split articles, stories that span pages.

items.title: Layout Detection & OCR
items.body:
Magazine pages aren't documents. Articles wrap around images, jump across pages, and share space with ads. Standard OCR gives you garbled soup.

Multi-column text recognition
Article boundary detection
Image and caption identification
Multi-page article tracking

items.title: Croatian Language AI
items.body:
Most AI models struggle with Croatian. Diacritical marks get mangled, context is lost, and business terminology comes out wrong.

Custom language model training
Diacritical mark preservation
Context-aware text correction
Author and title extraction

sections.title: Processing Pipeline
sections.lede: Four stages from raw PDF to structured, searchable content.

items.title: PDF Ingestion
items.body: Automated processing of scanned magazine pages with quality normalization

items.title: Layout Analysis
items.body: Computer vision for structure detection, segmentation, and reading order

items.title: OCR & Extraction
items.body: Text recognition with Croatian language processing and error correction

items.title: Data Structuring
items.body: Converting to searchable, structured format with metadata enrichment

sections.title: What We Built
sections.lede: Custom algorithms for the specific challenges of magazine digitization.

items.title: Multi-Page Tracking
items.body: Articles that continue on page 47 get automatically connected. Our algorithms track continuity markers and content flow across the entire magazine.

items.title: Author Recognition
items.body: Pattern recognition extracts and normalizes author information from various byline formats and positions within magazine layouts.

items.title: Auto-categorization
items.body: Machine learning classifies articles by topic, industry, and content type – making the archive instantly navigable by subject.

items.title: Post-Processing Pipeline
items.body:
Every extracted article runs through validation and quality control. Spell checking, format normalization, metadata enrichment, and deduplication happen automatically.

Automated quality scoring
Cross-reference validation
Human review queuing for edge cases

items.title: Full-text Indexing
items.body: Every word, every article, instantly searchable. The archive becomes a queryable database, ready for AI applications.

sections.title: Results & Impact
sections.lede: From locked PDFs to living, searchable archive.

items.title: Digital Preservation
items.body:
Decades of Croatian business journalism preserved in structured, future-proof format. Full-text search across the entire archive.

Complete archive digitization
Rich metadata for every article
Full-text search capability

items.title: AI-Ready Data
items.body:
The structured archive now powers Pitaj Lider – the AI assistant. What was locked in PDFs is now training data for business intelligence.

Powers AI assistants
Semantic search ready
RAG-compatible format

closing.title: Have Archives to Digitize?
closing.body: Our document AI handles complex layouts, multiple languages, and archives of any size. Let's talk about your digitization project.

meta.title: Lider digitalna arhiva - AI digitalizacija dokumenata | LumiVerse
meta.description: Digitalizacija više od 50.000 članaka iz magazina uz AI: vlastiti OCR, prepoznavanje prijeloma i hrvatski NLP pretvaraju desetljeća tiska u strukturirane podatke.

hr.title: Lider digitalna arhiva
hr.subtitle: Desetljeća poslovnog novinarstva, zaključana u PDF-ovima. Izgradili smo AI pipeline koji je izdvojio, strukturirao i indeksirao više od 50.000 članaka — i učinio ih pretraživima i spremnima za doba AI-ja.

showcase.alt: Izvorna stranica magazina Lider sa složenim višestupčanim prijelomom, slikama i hrvatskim tekstom - prikaz složenosti obrađenih dokumenata
showcase.caption: Izvorna stranica magazina s prikazom složenih prijeloma koje naš AI pipeline obrađuje

sections.title: Nije običan OCR posao
sections.lede: Prijelom magazina lomi standardnu obradu dokumenata — tekst u više stupaca, slike koje presijecaju članke, priče preko više stranica.

items.title: Prepoznavanje prijeloma i OCR
items.body:
Stranice magazina nisu dokumenti. Članci se ovijaju oko slika, preskaču na druge stranice i dijele prostor s oglasima. Standardni OCR daje nerazumljivu kašu.

Prepoznavanje teksta u više stupaca
Otkrivanje granica članka
Prepoznavanje slika i potpisa
Praćenje članaka kroz više stranica

items.title: AI za hrvatski jezik
items.body:
Većina AI modela muči se s hrvatskim. Dijakritički se znakovi izobliče, kontekst se izgubi, a poslovno nazivlje ispadne krivo.

Treniranje vlastitog jezičnog modela
Očuvanje dijakritičkih znakova
Ispravak teksta uz razumijevanje konteksta
Izdvajanje autora i naslova

items.title: Praćenje kroz stranice
items.body: Članci koji se nastavljaju na 47. stranici automatski se povezuju. Naši algoritmi prate oznake nastavka i tok sadržaja kroz cijeli magazin.

items.title: Prepoznavanje autora
items.body: Prepoznavanje obrazaca izvlači i ujednačava podatke o autoru iz različitih oblika i položaja potpisa unutar prijeloma.

items.body: Strojno učenje razvrstava članke po temi, djelatnosti i vrsti sadržaja — pa arhiva odmah postaje prohodna po predmetu.

items.title: Naknadna obrada

Svaki izdvojeni članak prolazi provjeru i kontrolu kvalitete. Provjera pravopisa, ujednačavanje formata, obogaćivanje metapodacima i uklanjanje duplikata odvijaju se automatski.

Automatsko ocjenjivanje kvalitete

items.body: Svaka riječ, svaki članak, odmah pretraživi. Arhiva postaje baza nad kojom se postavljaju upiti, spremna za AI primjene.
